annotations.title: Tick or untick one checklist item

description: [Sign-in required] Marks one checklist item done or not done — costs no credits and returns the item with its previous and new state. The item is addressed by the `id` get_checklist returns (stable even when the list changes) or by its `index` for items without an id; an item that does not exist is refused rather than created.

idempotency_key.description: any string of your choosing; the first result under it is returned again for 10 minutes

index.description: the index from get_checklist, when the item has no id

name: set_checklist_item

charged.description: credits actually spent; 0 today for every tool

summary.description: one human sentence about the result
